summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all eight paragraphs of the selected working Greek. Neither presents a concrete fidelity defect. Both preserve the three strikes, all seven stone conditions, the mountain-command negation, removal and replacement, passage through the gate, and the round stones’ deferred cutting and placement. Their notes distinguish editorial supplements from preserved Greek and accurately disclose the supplied edition-mediated reports, including the conflicting nearby-mountains alternative. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to this working source and disclosure of the supplied evidence; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
